player_prompt.intro:
Nga ni Player {player_id} mu Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma ikalamba {num_rounds} rounds.

Mfumo wa Game:
- Kabili ya kila ubwafya mwaliba {total_conversation_rounds} turns ya kubwafyana.
- Baada ya apo, bambi ba players balebeka ku cooperate nanti defect.

Payoff Matrix (fixed kila round):
- Bambi ba Cooperate ➜ kila {cooperate_reward}
- Bambi ba Defect ➜ kila {mutual_defect_reward}
- Umwine Defects, umwine Cooperates ➜ Defector {defect_reward}, Cooperator {sucker_reward}

Nga mwaiche:
- Ku conversation: tipe any text mwaiche.
- Ku decision phase: include '[Cooperate]' nanti '[Defect]' (case-insensitive). Mwaiche add extra text kabili/after token.

phases.conversation_finished: Ifyashi fisushi ku {round}. Nominisheni '[Cooperate]' or '[Defect]' mu {{}} ilingilile.
